name: webMockupPrimitive
title: Web Mockup
description: Browser/desktop chrome with an address bar, wrapping up to three landscape screens. Compose for dashboard or web UI.

screenMediaUrl.description: Single screen URL (used when `screens` is empty). Leave empty for placeholder.

screens.description: Multi-screen mode — sliding strip of screens. When set, ignores screenMediaUrl.

addressBarUrl.description: URL shown in browser chrome (browser frame only). Default "yourapp.com".

font.description: Font family for placeholder text. Default "Inter".

accent.description: Reserved brand accent (not used in chrome today). Default "#00e5a0".
